original.target_description: Study 5: binomial comparison of opposite directions of reversal between past-week and lifetime action/inaction regret, restricted to participants changing their response.

n.sample_role: Adults with discordant past-week versus lifetime regret choices. Analytic subset count not printed; 32 is the recruited sample, not the test denominator.
n.exclusions: Only participants with different responses across time periods entered this test; their count is not printed. No other exclusions reported.
n.location: p. 361 (PDF p. 5), Study 5 results and footnote 5

replication.target_description: Study 5: chi-square goodness-of-fit comparing participants showing action-to-inaction reversal versus the opposite reversal between past week and lifetime.

n.sample_role: Participants showing reversal between past-week and lifetime regret choices; subset of 535 regret-condition participants.
n.exclusions: Restricted to 265 participants showing reversal. Combined survey excluded 29 of 1017 before analysis; detailed exclusion criteria not in main text.
n.quote: 265 is the total number of participants who showed reversal

reported_success.location: Comparing Replication Findings to Original Findings and Extensions; Table 6
reported_success.quote: We failed to successfully replicate Study 5.

notes: The temporal-change test matches the description; original analytic n is not printed and is not replaced with recruited N=32. Replication effect is the printed V for the same chi-square test as p=.951; the separate McNemar test reports OR=0.99 and p=1 and is not mixed with this test.
